findings.claim: Owner-gap evidence does not map one-to-one to project proposals: Physical is proposal-review eligible, the whole Earth/Space region is not, cosmology/spacetime is separately eligible, and Earth-system sciences require scoping first.
MajorRegion boundaries are navigation projections and may be too broad or heterogeneous to serve as project boundaries.
Project proposal review can be justified by either coherent residual evidence or a coherent known-unworked frontier, but neither route establishes semantic owner admission.

The strongest next Atlas contribution is routing quality: preserving evidence and owner-boundary constraints while delegating actual charter/admission decisions to the Research System rather than expanding Atlas authority.

next: Materialize a technology-neutral handoff contract from Atlas proposal-review eligibility to Research System Question/Charter intake. Do not create the Physical or Cosmology project in Atlas. The next action should be a handoff schema/dogfood, not domain research.
